**Input:**

* `RDS_integrated_Seurat_T_B.rds` (03)

**Output:**

* `RDS_Tcells_annotated.rds` – T cells (singlets) with final annotation `Celltype_2`
* figures (`results/figures/`) and signature / ORA tables (`results/tables/`)

Steps

1. T-cell embedding (all days, 20 PCs) and Louvain clustering (resolution 0.8); doublets removed
2. Final annotation `Celltype_2` (Th0 I–VI, Pre-Tfh I/II/proliferating, Tfh, Pre-Th1 I/II/proliferating, Th1, Unknown 1–3)
3. Figures: UMAPs, composition per day, marker dot plots / heatmap
4. Module scores (MSigDB and custom signatures)
5. Composition after downsampling to the smallest sample
6. Over-representation of Day-6 Tfh / Th1 and Day-0 signatures in the markers of every population

**Figure panels produced here** (files in `results/figures/`, panel as prefix)

| panel | output |
|---|---|
| Fig. 2a | `Fig2a_UMAP_celltypes.pdf` |
| Fig. 2b | `Fig2b_DotPlot_markers_celltypes.pdf` |
| Fig. 2c | `Fig2c_UMAP_celltypes_per_day_downsampled.pdf` |
| Fig. 2d | `Fig2d_StackedBarplot_celltypes_per_day.pdf` |
| Fig. 2e | `Fig2e_Heatmap_TfhTh1_genes_zscore.pdf` |
| Fig. 3a | `Fig3a_Tcell_module_scores_grouped_zscore.pdf` |
| Fig. 6d (right) | `Fig6d_right_DotPlot_day6_Tfh_vs_Th1.pdf` |
| Suppl. Fig. 2b | `SuppFig2b_DotPlot_markers_by_day.pdf` |

All other figures (`F_*`, `Tcell_module_scores*`, `F_Enrichment_*`) are supporting plots that are not in the manuscript.
`RDS_Tcells_annotated.rds` is the reference for the label transfer in `05_TCR_CD62L_KLF2_mouse.ipynb` (Fig. 5d–f, 6c).

## Functions

### General helpers

```{r functions-general}
# Marker dot plot (blue-white-red) used throughout the annotation
marker_dotplot <- function(object, group.by) {
  DotPlot(object, features = features_plot, group.by = group.by, assay = "RNA") +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0,
                          space = "Lab", na.value = "grey50") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))
}

# UMAP by sample + UMAP by cluster + marker dot plot
umap_cluster_overview <- function(object, rel_widths_top = c(1, 1), rel_heights = c(1, 1)) {
  p1 <- DimPlot(object, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", cols = color_vector_samples) +
    ggtitle("T cells colored by sample")
  p2 <- DimPlot(object, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
    ggtitle("T cells colored by cluster")
  p3 <- marker_dotplot(object, group.by = "seurat_clusters")

  top_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, labels = c("A", "B"), align = 'h', rel_widths = rel_widths_top)
  cowplot::plot_grid(top_row, p3, labels = c("", "C"), ncol = 1, rel_heights = rel_heights)
}
```

### Signature over-representation analysis (ORA)

```{r functions-ora}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract an up-regulated gene signature from a FindMarkers table
# ------------------------------------------------------------
extract_signature <- function(marker_table, logfc_cutoff = 1, padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  marker_table %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    filter(avg_log2FC > logfc_cutoff, p_val_adj <= padj_cutoff) %>%
    pull(Gene) %>%
    unique()
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One-sided Fisher ORA per cluster (signature NOT restricted to universe)
# Used for the first, cluster-level analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_ora_unrestricted <- function(degs_filtered, signature_genes, gene_universe, type_name) {
  ora_results <- degs_filtered %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      a = length(intersect(gene, signature_genes)),                        # interest ∩ DEG
      b = length(setdiff(gene, signature_genes)),                          # DEG not in interest
      c = length(setdiff(signature_genes, gene)),                          # interest not DEG
      d = length(setdiff(gene_universe, union(gene, signature_genes))),    # not in either
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      p_value = fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), alternative = "greater")$p.value,
      odds_ratio = fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), alternative = "greater")$estimate
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  ora_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(ora_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  ora_results %>% mutate(Type = type_name)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# One-sided Fisher ORA per cluster (signature restricted to universe)
# Used for the per-day analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_ora <- function(degs_filtered, signature_genes, gene_universe, type_name) {

  # Only genes measurable in the current dataset
  signature_genes <- intersect(unique(signature_genes), gene_universe)

  ora_results <- degs_filtered %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(
      a = length(intersect(gene, signature_genes)),                        # marker AND signature
      b = length(setdiff(gene, signature_genes)),                          # marker, not signature
      c = length(setdiff(signature_genes, gene)),                          # signature, not marker
      d = length(setdiff(gene_universe, union(gene, signature_genes))),    # neither
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fisher_result = list(
        fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), alternative = "greater")
      ),
      p_value = fisher_result$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(fisher_result$estimate)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-fisher_result)

  # BH correction across cell types
  ora_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(ora_results$p_value, method = "BH")
  ora_results %>% mutate(Type = type_name)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ORA for all grouped populations (incl. populations without markers)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
run_signature_ora <- function(degs_filtered, signature_genes, gene_universe,
                              signature_name, celltype_levels) {

  signature_genes <- intersect(unique(signature_genes), gene_universe)

  if (length(signature_genes) == 0) {
    stop(paste("Empty signature:", signature_name))
  }

  ora_results <- lapply(celltype_levels, function(ct) {

    cluster_genes <- degs_filtered %>%
      filter(as.character(cluster) == ct) %>%
      pull(gene) %>%
      unique()
    cluster_genes <- intersect(cluster_genes, gene_universe)

    # Contingency table
    a <- length(intersect(cluster_genes, signature_genes))
    b <- length(setdiff(cluster_genes, signature_genes))
    c <- length(setdiff(signature_genes, cluster_genes))
    d <- length(setdiff(gene_universe, union(cluster_genes, signature_genes)))

    ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE), alternative = "greater")

    data.frame(
      cluster = ct,
      a = a, b = b, c = c, d = d,
      overlap = a,
      n_markers = length(cluster_genes),
      signature_size = length(signature_genes),
      p_value = ft$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  ora_results %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
      Type = signature_name,
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = celltype_levels)
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Bin adjusted P values for the heatmaps
# ------------------------------------------------------------
bin_padj <- function(p_adj, symbol = "≤") {
  lv <- c("> 0.1", paste(symbol, c("0.1", "0.01", "0.001", "0.0001")))
  bins <- case_when(
    is.na(p_adj) ~ lv[1],
    p_adj <= 0.0001 ~ lv[5],
    p_adj <= 0.001 ~ lv[4],
    p_adj <= 0.01 ~ lv[3],
    p_adj <= 0.1 ~ lv[2],
    TRUE ~ lv[1]
  )
  factor(bins, levels = lv)
}

padj_fill_scale <- function(symbol = "≤", name = "adjusted P") {
  lv <- c("> 0.1", paste(symbol, c("0.1", "0.01", "0.001", "0.0001")))
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(c("grey80", "#fee08b", "#f46d43", "#d73027", "#7f0000"), lv),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = name
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Analyze one day: markers per Celltype_2, ORA for T0 / Tfh / Th1, heatmap
# ------------------------------------------------------------
analyze_day <- function(seurat_object, day_name, tfh_signature, th1_signature,
                        t0_signature, cluster_order) {

  message("\n========================================")
  message("Analyzing: ", day_name)
  message("========================================")

  # Subset to current day
  day_object <- subset(seurat_object, subset = orig.ident == day_name)
  DefaultAssay(day_object) <- "RNA"

  # IMPORTANT: use Celltype_2 rather than seurat_clusters
  Idents(day_object) <- "Celltype_2"

  # Remove Unknown populations
  cells_keep <- rownames(day_object@meta.data)[
    !is.na(day_object$Celltype_2) &
      !day_object$Celltype_2 %in% unknown_types
  ]
  day_object <- subset(day_object, cells = cells_keep)

  # QC: cells per Celltype_2
  message("\nCell numbers:")
  print(table(day_object$Celltype_2))

  # Gene universe
  gene_universe <- rownames(day_object[["RNA"]])

  # Markers for every Celltype_2
  signature.cell.markers <- FindAllMarkers(day_object, only.pos = TRUE)

  degs_filtered <- signature.cell.markers %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.1) %>%
    filter(gene %in% gene_universe)

  # ORA per signature
  ora_results_tfh <- run_ora(degs_filtered, tfh_signature, gene_universe, "Tfh")
  ora_results_th1 <- run_ora(degs_filtered, th1_signature, gene_universe, "Th1")
  ora_results_t0  <- run_ora(degs_filtered, t0_signature, gene_universe, "T0")

  combined_ora <- bind_rows(ora_results_tfh, ora_results_th1, ora_results_t0)

  # Heatmap data
  heatmap_data <- combined_ora %>%
    mutate(cluster = as.character(cluster)) %>%
    filter(!cluster %in% unknown_types) %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster, p_adj, odds_ratio, Type) %>%
    tidyr::complete(cluster, Type) %>%
    mutate(
      cluster = factor(cluster, levels = cluster_order),
      Type = factor(Type, levels = c("T0", "Tfh", "Th1")),
      p_bin = bin_padj(p_adj, symbol = "<=")
    )

  # Heatmap
  p <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = cluster, y = Type, fill = p_bin)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    padj_fill_scale(symbol = "<=") +
    labs(title = paste("Signature enrichment -", day_name), x = "Cell type", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fig_dir, "F_Enrichment_", day_name, "_Celltype2.pdf"),
    plot = p, width = 7, height = 3
  )

  list(
    day = day_name,
    object = day_object,
    markers = signature.cell.markers,
    degs_filtered = degs_filtered,
    ora_tfh = ora_results_tfh,
    ora_th1 = ora_results_th1,
    ora_t0 = ora_results_t0,
    combined_ora = combined_ora,
    heatmap_data = heatmap_data,
    plot = p
  )
}
```

# T cell embedding and annotation

The annotation was developed iteratively (reference embedding of Day 0 + Day 6 with mapping of Day 2 + 4, and a
first cluster annotation); the final annotation below is based only on the embedding of all days together.

## Final embedding: all days together

All days embedded together: 20 PCs, Louvain resolution 0.8; doublets (scDblFinder) removed.

```{r umap-check-t-20, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8, fig.cap = "UMAP of all T cells (20 dimensions). (A) Sample (B) Seurat Clusters (C) Dotplot showing marker genes."}
DefaultAssay(t_cells) <- "RNA"
all.genes <- rownames(t_cells)
t_cells <- ScaleData(t_cells, features = all.genes)

DefaultAssay(t_cells) <- "integrated"
t_cells <- ScaleData(t_cells, verbose = FALSE)
t_cells <- RunPCA(t_cells, npcs = 25, verbose = FALSE)
t_cells <- FindNeighbors(t_cells, dims = 1:20)
t_cells <- FindClusters(t_cells, resolution = 0.8)
t_cells <- RunUMAP(t_cells, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE)
t_cells <- subset(t_cells, Doublets == "singlet")

umap_cluster_overview(t_cells)
```

## Final annotation (Celltype_2)

```{r final-annotation, fig.width = 8}
Idents(t_cells) <- "seurat_clusters"
new.cluster.ids <- c("Th0 I", "Th0 II", "Tfh", "Th0 IV", "Th0 III", "Pre-Th1 I",
                     "Pre-Th1 proliferating", "Pre-Tfh I", "Pre-Tfh II", "Th0 V", "Th0 VI", "Th1",
                     "Pre-Th1 II", "Unknown 1", "Pre-Tfh proliferating", "Unknown 2", "Unknown 3")
names(new.cluster.ids) <- levels(t_cells)
t_cells <- RenameIdents(t_cells, new.cluster.ids)
t_cells <- AddMetaData(object = t_cells, metadata = Idents(t_cells), col.name = 'Celltype_2')

t_cells@meta.data$Celltype_2 <- factor(
  t_cells@meta.data$Celltype_2,
  levels = c("Th0 I", "Th0 II", "Th0 III", "Th0 IV", "Th0 V", "Th0 VI",
             "Tfh", "Pre-Tfh I", "Pre-Tfh II", "Pre-Tfh proliferating",
             "Th1", "Pre-Th1 I", "Pre-Th1 II", "Pre-Th1 proliferating",
             "Unknown 1", "Unknown 2", "Unknown 3"))

DimPlot(t_cells, reduction = "umap", label = F, repel = TRUE, group.by = "Celltype_2", cols = celltype_colors_3) +
  ggtitle("T cells colored by cluster")
```

```{r final-annotation-split, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 6}
DimPlot(t_cells, reduction = "umap", group.by = 'Celltype_2', split.by = "orig.ident", cols = celltype_colors_2)
```

**Figure 2e** – mean expression of (pre-)Tfh and (pre-)Th1 genes per population, z-scored per gene.

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Heatmap: mean expression per Celltype_3, z-scored per gene
# ------------------------------------------------------------
genes_tfh <- c("Zbtb20", "Slc9a9", "Arid5b", "Cd226", "Bcl6")
genes_th1 <- c("Lyar", "Fabp5", "Cenpw", "Il2ra", "Tbx21")
genes_hm  <- c(genes_tfh, genes_th1)

# Check that all genes are present
setdiff(genes_hm, rownames(t_cells_f))

# Mean log-normalized expression per cell type
expr <- GetAssayData(t_cells_f, slot = "data", assay = "RNA")[genes_hm, ]
grp  <- t_cells_f@meta.data$Celltype_3

avg <- sapply(levels(grp), function(ct) Matrix::rowMeans(expr[, grp == ct, drop = FALSE]))

# z-score per gene across cell types
z <- t(scale(t(avg)))

hm_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(z))
colnames(hm_df) <- c("Gene", "Celltype", "z")

hm_df <- hm_df %>%
  mutate(
    Group = factor(ifelse(Gene %in% genes_tfh, "Up in (Pre-)Tfh", "Up in (Pre-)Th1"),
                   levels = c("Up in (Pre-)Tfh", "Up in (Pre-)Th1")),
    Gene = factor(Gene, levels = genes_hm),
    Celltype = factor(Celltype, levels = rev(levels(grp)))   # first cell type on top
  )

p_hm <- ggplot(hm_df, aes(x = Gene, y = Celltype, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.3) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2c4fa3", mid = "white", high = "#d6263a", midpoint = 0,
```

```{r fig-dotplot-by-day, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
days <- unique(as.character(t_cells_f$orig.ident))

# 1) dot plots per day (without scales)

  DotPlot(object_day, features = features_plot, group.by = "Celltype_3",

      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    coord_flip()
})

# 2) common limits across days
all_dat   <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dotplots_by_day, function(p) p$data))
col_lim   <- range(all_dat$avg.exp.scaled, na.rm = TRUE)
col_lim   <- c(-1, 1) * max(abs(col_lim))           # symmetric around 0
size_lim  <- c(0, max(all_dat$pct.exp, na.rm = TRUE))

# 3) identical scales for all plots
dotplots_by_day <- lapply(dotplots_by_day, function(p) {
  suppressMessages(
    p +
      scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0,
                            limits = col_lim, space = "Lab", na.value = "grey50",
                            name = "Average\nExpression") +
      scale_size(limits = size_lim, range = c(0, 6), name = "Percent\nExpressed")
  )
})
```

```{r module-genes-present}
DefaultAssay(t_cells) <- "RNA"

min_pct_expressed <- 0.05

expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(t_cells, layer = "counts", assay = "RNA")
expr_bin <- expr_matrix > 0

# Fraction of expressing cells per cell type
cells_by_type <- split(colnames(t_cells), t_cells$Celltype_2)
cells_by_type <- cells_by_type[names(cells_by_type) %in% cluster_order]

pct_by_type <- sapply(cells_by_type, function(cells) Matrix::rowMeans(expr_bin[, cells, drop = FALSE]))

# Keep genes expressed in >= 5% of cells in at least one cell type
genes_expressed <- rownames(pct_by_type)[apply(pct_by_type, 1, max) >= min_pct_expressed]

signature_genes_present <- lapply(signature_genes, function(genes) intersect(genes, genes_expressed))

data.frame(
  signature = names(signature_genes),
  n_original = sapply(signature_genes, length),
  n_in_object = sapply(signature_genes, function(g) length(intersect(g, rownames(t_cells)))),
  n_used = sapply(signature_genes_present, length)
)

# Safety: AddModuleScore fails on empty signatures
empty_signatures <- names(signature_genes_present)[sapply(signature_genes_present, length) == 0]
if (length(empty_signatures) > 0) {
  warning("No genes left after filtering, signature removed: ",
          paste(empty_signatures, collapse = ", "))
  signature_genes_present <- signature_genes_present[!names(signature_genes_present) %in% empty_signatures]
}

```

## Module scores per grouped cell type

```{r module-plotdata-grouped}
plot_df <- t_cells@meta.data %>%
  select(Celltype_2, all_of(score_columns)) %>%
  mutate(Celltype_2 = as.character(Celltype_2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Celltype_2), !Celltype_2 %in% unknown_types) %>%
  # Collapse internal subclusters
  mutate(
    Celltype_grouped = case_when(
      Celltype_2 %in% c("Th0 I", "Th0 II", "Th0 III", "Th0 IV", "Th0 V", "Th0 VI") ~ "Th0",
      Celltype_2 %in% c("Pre-Tfh I", "Pre-Tfh II") ~ "Pre-Tfh",
      Celltype_2 == "Pre-Tfh proliferating" ~ "Pre-Tfh proliferating",
      Celltype_2 == "Tfh" ~ "Tfh",
      Celltype_2 %in% c("Pre-Th1 I", "Pre-Th1 II") ~ "Pre-Th1",
      Celltype_2 == "Pre-Th1 proliferating" ~ "Pre-Th1 proliferating",
      Celltype_2 == "Th1" ~ "Th1",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Celltype_grouped)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(score_columns), names_to = "signature", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(
    signature = recode(
      signature,
      E2F_score1 = "E2F targets",
      G2M_score1 = "G2/M checkpoint",
      STAT3_score1 = "IL-6/JAK/STAT3",
      STAT5_score1 = "IL-2/STAT5",
      IFN_ALPHA_score1 = "IFN alpha",
      IFN_GAMMA_score1 = "IFN gamma",
      Cytokine_production_score1 = "Cytokine production",
      TCR_Signaling_score1 = "TCR Signaling",
      Secretion_score1 = "Secretion",
      Cytokines_score1 = "Cytokines",
      Cytokine_receptors_score1 = "Cytokine receptors",
      Cytokine_activity_score1 = "Cytokine activity",
      Chemokine_activity_score1 = "Chemokine activity"
    ),
    signature = factor(signature, levels = signature_order),
    Celltype_grouped = factor(Celltype_grouped, levels = celltype_grouped_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(score))
```

**Figure 3a** – module scores (z-standardised) per grouped population (boxplots, second plot of this chunk). The boxplots on the raw scale above and the z-score heatmap are not in the manuscript.

```{r module-scores-zscore, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4}
# ============================================================
# z-standardize each module score across all cells
# (per signature: mean 0, SD 1) -> comparable relative differences
# ============================================================

plot_df_z <- plot_df %>%filter(signature %in% small_signatures) %>% mutate(signature = factor(signature, levels = small_signatures)) %>%
  group_by(signature) %>%
  mutate(z = (score - mean(score)) / sd(score)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Heatmap: mean z-score per grouped cell type
# ------------------------------------------------------------
heat_df <- plot_df_z %>%
  group_by(signature, Celltype_grouped) %>%
  summarise(mean_z = mean(z), .groups = "drop")

p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = Celltype_grouped, y = signature, fill = mean_z)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean_z)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "Mean z-score") +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(heat_df$signature))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
p_heat

ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "Tcell_module_scores_zscore_heatmap.pdf"), plot = p_heat,
       width = 4, height = 3, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Boxplots on a common z-scale (fixed y-axis across panels)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_z <- ggplot(plot_df_z, aes(x = Celltype_grouped, y = z, fill = Celltype_grouped)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.7, size = 0.2,          # outline + whiskers thinner (default ~0.5)
               fatten = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors_grouped) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 3)) +
  facet_wrap(~signature, ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  labs(x = "Cell type", y = "Module score (z)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.line = element_line(size = 0.25),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.25),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(1.5, "pt"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text()
  )

ggsave(filename = paste0(fig_dir, "Fig3a_Tcell_module_scores_grouped_zscore.pdf"), plot = p_z,
       width = 2.5, height = 0.3 * nlevels(plot_df_z$signature) + 1.2,
       units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
```

# Downsampling of T cells

Day 0 contributes far more cells than the other days. For the composition plots every day is therefore randomly downsampled to the size of the smallest sample (Day 2, 3,091 cells).

```{r plot-dsimmune, fig.width = 5, fig.cap = "UMAP of the downsampled T cells"}
set.seed(123)
smallest_sample <- t_cells@meta.data$orig.ident %>% table()
barcodes <- t_cells@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column('Barcodes') %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  slice_sample(n = min(smallest_sample)) %>%
  pull(Barcodes)

downsampleData <- subset(t_cells, cells = barcodes)
DimPlot(downsampleData, reduction = "umap", group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.8")
```

# Tfh / Th1 / T0 signature enrichment (ORA)

## Signatures from the data (Celltype_2)

```{r ora-universe}
# Genes expressed in >= 5% of all T cells
min.cells <- round(dim(t_cells@meta.data)[1] * 0.05, 0)
normalized_matrix <- GetAssayData(t_cells, layer = "counts", assay = "RNA")
t_cells2 <- subset(t_cells,
                   features = rownames(normalized_matrix)[Matrix::rowSums(normalized_matrix > 0) >= min.cells])
universe <- rownames(t_cells2@assays$RNA)
```

```{r ora-signature-markers}
t_cells2@meta.data$Day_Celltype <- paste0(t_cells2@meta.data$orig.ident, "_", t_cells2@meta.data$Celltype_2)
Idents(t_cells2) <- "Day_Celltype"
DefaultAssay(t_cells2) <- "RNA"
signature.th1_day6 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day6_Th1")
signature.tfh_day6 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day6_Tfh")

Idents(t_cells2) <- "orig.ident"
signature.t0_day0 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day0")

# Signatures: log2FC > 1, adj. P <= 0.05
tfh_signature <- extract_signature(signature.tfh_day6)
th1_signature <- extract_signature(signature.th1_day6)
t0_signature  <- extract_signature(signature.t0_day0)

tfh_signature %>% write.csv(paste0(table_dir, "Tfh_signature_Celltype2.csv"))
th1_signature %>% write.csv(paste0(table_dir, "Th1_signature_Celltype2.csv"))
t0_signature %>% write.csv(paste0(table_dir, "T0_signature_Celltype2.csv"))

length(tfh_signature)
length(th1_signature)
length(t0_signature)
```

## ORA across all days

```{r ora-all-days}
Idents(t_cells2) <- "Celltype_2"
DefaultAssay(t_cells2) <- "RNA"
signature.cell.markers <- FindAllMarkers(t_cells2, only.pos = TRUE)

gene_universe <- rownames(t_cells2@assays$RNA)

degs_filtered <- signature.cell.markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.1) %>%
  filter(gene %in% gene_universe)

ora_results_tfh <- run_ora_unrestricted(degs_filtered, tfh_signature, gene_universe, "Tfh")
ora_results_th1 <- run_ora_unrestricted(degs_filtered, th1_signature, gene_universe, "Th1")
ora_results_t0  <- run_ora_unrestricted(degs_filtered, t0_signature, gene_universe, "T0")

print(ora_results_tfh)
print(ora_results_th1)
print(ora_results_t0)

combined_ora <- rbind(ora_results_tfh, ora_results_th1, ora_results_t0)
```

## ORA on grouped populations

```{r grouped-annotation}
t_cells$Celltype_grouped <- case_when(
  t_cells$Celltype_2 %in% c("Th0 I", "Th0 II", "Th0 III", "Th0 IV", "Th0 V", "Th0 VI") ~ "Th0",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 %in% c("Pre-Tfh I", "Pre-Tfh II") ~ "Pre-Tfh",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 == "Pre-Tfh proliferating" ~ "Pre-Tfh proliferating",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 == "Tfh" ~ "Tfh",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 %in% c("Pre-Th1 I", "Pre-Th1 II") ~ "Pre-Th1",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 == "Pre-Th1 proliferating" ~ "Pre-Th1 proliferating",
  t_cells$Celltype_2 == "Th1" ~ "Th1",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

t_cells$Celltype_grouped <- factor(t_cells$Celltype_grouped, levels = celltype_levels)

# Check annotations
table(t_cells$Celltype_grouped, useNA = "ifany")

# Check which annotations were not grouped (should only be Unknowns)
unique(t_cells$Celltype_2[is.na(t_cells$Celltype_grouped)])
```

```{r grouped-universe}
# Genes expressed in >= 5% of all T cells
DefaultAssay(t_cells) <- "RNA"

min.cells <- round(dim(t_cells@meta.data)[1] * 0.05, 0)
normalized_matrix <- GetAssayData(t_cells, layer = "counts", assay = "RNA")
t_cells2 <- subset(t_cells,
                   features = rownames(normalized_matrix)[Matrix::rowSums(normalized_matrix > 0) >= min.cells])
universe <- rownames(t_cells2@assays$RNA)

cat("Cells:", ncol(t_cells2), "\n")
cat("Genes retained:", length(universe), "\n")
```

```{r grouped-signatures}
t_cells2$Day_Celltype <- paste0(t_cells2$orig.ident, "_", t_cells2$Celltype_grouped)
DefaultAssay(t_cells2) <- "RNA"

# Day 6 Tfh and Th1 signatures
Idents(t_cells2) <- "Day_Celltype"
signature.tfh_day6 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day6_Tfh", only.pos = TRUE)
signature.th1_day6 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day6_Th1", only.pos = TRUE)

# Day 0 signature
Idents(t_cells2) <- "orig.ident"
signature.t0_day0 <- FindMarkers(t_cells2, ident.1 = "Day0", only.pos = TRUE)

# Extract signatures, restricted to the tested gene universe
tfh_signature <- intersect(extract_signature(signature.tfh_day6), universe)
th1_signature <- intersect(extract_signature(signature.th1_day6), universe)
t0_signature  <- intersect(extract_signature(signature.t0_day0), universe)

# Export
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = tfh_signature), paste0(table_dir, "Tfh_signature.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = th1_signature), paste0(table_dir, "Th1_signature.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(Gene = t0_signature), paste0(table_dir, "T0_signature.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

data.frame(
  Signature = c("Tfh", "Th1", "T0"),
  N_genes = c(length(tfh_signature), length(th1_signature), length(t0_signature))
)
```

```{r grouped-markers}
Idents(t_cells2) <- "Celltype_grouped"
DefaultAssay(t_cells2) <- "RNA"

signature.cell.markers <- FindAllMarkers(t_cells2, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)

degs_filtered <- signature.cell.markers %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.1, gene %in% universe)
```

```{r grouped-ora}
ora_results_tfh <- run_signature_ora(degs_filtered, tfh_signature, universe, "Tfh", celltype_levels)
ora_results_th1 <- run_signature_ora(degs_filtered, th1_signature, universe, "Th1", celltype_levels)
ora_results_t0  <- run_signature_ora(degs_filtered, t0_signature, universe, "T0", celltype_levels)

ora_results_all <- bind_rows(ora_results_tfh, ora_results_th1, ora_results_t0)
print(ora_results_all)

write.csv(ora_results_all, paste0(table_dir, "ORA_grouped_Tcells.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r grouped-ora-heatmap}
heatmap_data <- ora_results_all %>%
```
